title: Skill Can Make It Good; Dedication Makes It Timeless.
description: A branding project came in, and I had my first meeting with the founder, Mr Raghav Kohli, and the promoter, Mr Deepak Sahni. Deepak and I had worked together before on several brands, so there was already a shared understanding of how a brand story can help and inspire me.

blocks.heading: A branding project came in, and I had my first meeting with the founder, *Mr Raghav Kohli*, and the promoter, *Mr Deepak Sahni*. Deepak and I had worked together before on several brands, so there was already a shared understanding of how a brand story can help and inspire me.
The brand was a Japanese matcha tea brand. They wanted to call it HIKARI.

The story was not simply about flavour or authenticity, even though the product was made with pure Japanese ingredients. *It wasn't about replacing a habit, or even about how matcha could become part of a luxury lifestyle.*
